purpose: Literature-sourced trajectory invariants crawled for Phase 2 item 03 and computed on the causal 0-50% window (ticks 1..75) of all 591,171 cells.

operators.name: hvg_degree_entropy
operators.formula: H(d) = -sum_k p_k log2 p_k over the horizontal-visibility-graph degree distribution
operators.reference: Luque, Lacasa, Ballesteros & Luque, Phys. Rev. E 80, 046103 (2009), doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.80.046103
operators.note: iid series produce P(k)=(1/3)(2/3)^(k-2) regardless of amplitude law

operators.name: hvg_entropy_gap
operators.formula: H_empirical - H_theory with H_theory = 2.754888 bits for the iid exponential law
operators.note: positive gap = excess order vs white noise

operators.name: hh_inst_freq_mean
operators.reference: Huang et al., Proc. R. Soc. A 454, 903 (1998)

operators.name: levy_area_z
operators.formula: A = 0.5*(int t dy - int y dt), normalized by total variation
operators.reference: Chevyrev & Kormilitzin, arXiv:1603.03788 eq. (12); Lyons (1998) rough path theory

operators.name: rqa_det
operators.formula: DET = sum(diagonal recurrence lengths >= 2) / total recurrence (16-pt delay embedding)
operators.reference: Marwan, Romano, Thiel & Kurths, Phys. Rep. 438, 237 (2007)

operators.name: perm_entropy
operators.formula: H = -sum p(pi) ln p(pi) / ln 6 over the 6 ordinal patterns of order 3
